title: K600: Session Meta-Analysis and Milestone Report — 59 Experiments, What Did We Learn?
scope: Session experiments K526-K598 (59 experiments with result files, ~74 K-numbers allocated)

session_statistics.missing_explanation: K555 skipped, K578-K590 gap (literature/synthesis/non-experiment tasks), K585 read-only synthesis, K596 gap

strategy_search.description: Searching for new VT overlay signals/timing methods

strategy_validation.description: Deep validation (8-point checklists) for listing candidates

prediction.description: Volatility prediction models (HAR, GARCH variants, window analysis)

theory.description: Theoretical frameworks (insurance pricing, regime maps, cost decomposition)

methodology.description: ML, NLP, HMM, EVT methodological explorations

strategies_listed_detail: piecewise_conservative (K568/K569) — Conservative VT with VIX cutoffs

B1_HAR_prediction.finding: HAR multi-scale framework universally crushes GARCH for volatility prediction across all 7 assets tested (DM t=-12 to -22, all p<0.001). HAR-VIX best for SPY (QLIKE 0.46 vs GJR 1.51). Rough volatility H=0.10 confirmed.
B1_HAR_prediction.paper_impact: Major addition to Leverage-Direction paper Complexity Ceiling table
B1_HAR_prediction.trading_impact: None — best predictor is worst strategy (K533/K540 paradox)

B2_VIX_conditional_leverage.finding: VIX<15 → leverage 1.5x produces Harvey t=7.90, 11/11 cross-OOS wins, Sharpe 1.553, CAGR 19.0%. First genuinely new strategy from 51 experiments of searching.

B3_Taiwan_adaptation.finding: Taiwan requires local RV22 or VIX percentile (not absolute VIX thresholds). Harvey t=4.79, 18/18 OOS. Demonstrates that the framework exports but parameters must be locally calibrated.

L1_prediction_trading_disconnect.lesson: The best prediction model (HAR, QLIKE 0.46) produces the WORST trading strategy (Sharpe 1.12). Prediction accuracy and trading profitability are fundamentally different objectives.
L1_prediction_trading_disconnect.evidence: K530/K533: HAR-ABS DM=-15.45 vs GJR but Sharpe 1.12 vs 12/VIX 1.75. K540: HAR-VIX ensemble +0.004 Sharpe (NS). K594: Adaptive window prediction improvement → 0 trading improvement.

L2_VIX_sufficiency_wall.lesson: VIX contains essentially ALL actionable information for equity timing. No derivative, composite, ML, or alternative signal adds statistically significant value.
L2_VIX_sufficiency_wall.evidence: VIX sufficiency confirmed by: K531 (sentiment), K535 (skewness), K537 (cross-asset), K538/K541 (ML), K539 (VRP), K542/K564 (term structure), K543 (drawdown, 77% redundant), K546/K557 (gold timing), K550 (adaptive threshold), K554 (HMM, R²=0.0002), K559 (dispersion), K570 (earnings), K576 (clustering)
L2_VIX_sufficiency_wall.count: Confirmed 15+ times this session, 40+ times total across all sessions

L3_daily_rebalancing_artifact.lesson: Daily rebalancing creates massive Sharpe inflation (2.157 daily → 1.228 monthly for sector momentum). This is a microstructure artifact, not genuine alpha.
L3_daily_rebalancing_artifact.evidence: K560/K562/K563 (sector rotation), K566 (factor timing), K577 (leverage). All show monotonic alpha decay with frequency reduction.

L4_portfolio_construction_over_signals.lesson: Portfolio construction improvements (leverage sizing, allocation rules, safety mechanisms) yield more alpha than signal discovery. All 5 listed strategies modify HOW to invest, not WHEN.
L4_portfolio_construction_over_signals.evidence: 22 signal-search experiments → 0 listed. 11 validation experiments → 5 listed. All listed strategies use VIX as the sole signal with different portfolio construction rules.

L5_conservative_design_is_robust.lesson: Conservative, rule-based designs survive validation better than optimized ones. Piecewise VT (Sharpe 1.875, MDD -4.9%) uses only 2 parameters. Adaptive Tier uses 3 fixed VIX thresholds.
L5_conservative_design_is_robust.evidence: K568/K569 (piecewise), K595 (adaptive tier), K598 (debounce worsens — 77% of 'false exits' are actually protective)

most_productive_direction.why: 22 signal-search experiments found nothing new, but 11 validation experiments produced 5 listed strategies and 7 theoretical insights. The shift from 'find a better signal' to 'build a better portfolio with the same signal' was the key pivot.
most_productive_direction.output: 5 listed strategies, 7 theory papers, 10 experience records

biggest_waste_of_time.why: 22 experiments testing whether any signal (cross-asset, ML, VRP, term structure, drawdown, momentum, calendar, sector, factor, gold regime, dispersion) can beat 12/VIX. ALL null. VIX sufficiency was already established by K458 meta-analysis but we kept trying.
biggest_waste_of_time.count: 22 experiments, 0 positive results at Harvey threshold
biggest_waste_of_time.should_have_stopped_after: K542 (8th consecutive null), pivoted to portfolio construction

session_narrative.phase_1_prediction_K526_K536: Opened with prediction models (GARCH-MIDAS, Volume-GARCH, rough vol, HAR). HAR breakthrough (K530) validated across 7 assets (K532). EVT-VaR contribution (K536). Established prediction ceiling.
session_narrative.phase_2_signal_search_K537_K566: Massive but futile signal search. Cross-asset momentum (K537), ML meta-labeling (K538/K541), VRP (K539), term structure (K542/K564), drawdown (K543), calendar (K547/K570), sector rotation (K560-K563), factor timing (K566). All null vs VIX.
session_narrative.phase_3_leverage_breakthrough_K548_K558: Embedded within Phase 2, found that LEVERAGE (not signals) is the lever. K548 VIX-conditional leverage (t=7.90). K553 Taiwan adaptation (t=4.79). Both through 8-point validation.
session_narrative.phase_4_theory_K568_K577: Theoretical deepening: optimal weight function (K568), VIX regime map (K572), insurance pricing (K573), complete backtest (K574), life stage matching (K575), rebalancing frequency (K577).
session_narrative.phase_5_synthesis_K583_K598: Literature review (K590), advanced models (K591-K592 MF2-GARCH, window sweep), hybrid strategies (K595), stress testing (K597), and the realization that debouncing hurts (K598).

next_session_recommendations.R1: STOP searching for VIX alternatives. 40+ confirmations is enough. Redirect all signal-search effort to other dimensions.
next_session_recommendations.R2: Focus on out-of-sample live tracking. 5 strategies listed but only days of live data. Need 3-6 months of paper trading to confirm.
next_session_recommendations.R3: Expand cross-market testing. K567 showed international VT leverage not universal. Need Taiwan-specific and EM-specific research.
next_session_recommendations.R4: Pursue high-frequency / intraday research with the 5-min data infrastructure already built. HAR benefits from multi-scale; 5-min data enables this.
next_session_recommendations.R5: Theory papers deserve dedicated effort. Insurance pricing (K573), regime maps (K572), VIX sufficiency proof — these are publishable standalone.
next_session_recommendations.R6: Platform product development. 197 articles but SEO not set up, no email notifications live. Research output exceeds distribution capacity.

milestone_significance.K600_meaning: K600 marks 600 experiments since the research system began. This session (K526-K598) represents the transition from 'model exploration' to 'portfolio construction' — the realization that the prediction problem was solved (HAR) but the trading problem requires different thinking (leverage, risk allocation, conservative design).
milestone_significance.cumulative: 1363 knowledge entries, 28 experience records, 3 papers, 14 strategies, 700+ articles. The system has generated more experimental evidence than most PhD dissertations.
milestone_significance.intellectual_contribution: The central finding — that VIX sufficiency is so complete that no alternative signal survives statistical scrutiny, and that portfolio construction dominates signal discovery — is itself a publishable result.
